correctness.rationale: All 18 morphisms are enumerated by 3 balanced four-letter images u beginning with 0 and 6 balanced images v. For u≠v, the finite base P(d)={0,1}^2 for distances d=1,2,3 and the four residue-lifting identities are exact enumerations over 15 morphisms. For d=4q+r≥4, source separations q and q+floor((t+r)/4) are positive smaller than d; induction provides every endpoint pair. A factor of length 4q+r has 2 per full block and a computable prefix/suffix correction, and attained one-count values form an integer interval by sliding one position. The resulting 18-row residue table follows, including complexity 5 at multiples of 4 for 0011/1100; u=v yields periodic words. Independent exhaustive base/lift check succeeded for 105 predicates and sliding-window counts in 1,440 length/morphism cases n≤80. The finite sample is not the infinite proof.
